title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
h1: Base64 Encoder & Decoder — Encode and Decode Text Free
seoTitle: Base64 Encoder Decoder — Free Online UTF-8 Tool
description: Encode any text to Base64 or decode Base64 strings back to readable text. Correct UTF-8 handling, runs privately in your browser with no uploads or sign-up.
intro: Paste text to turn it into Base64, or paste Base64 to recover the original text. Encoding and decoding happen entirely on your device so sensitive strings never leave your browser.
blurb: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text — free, private, and UTF-8 safe.

controls.label: Text or Base64
controls.placeholder: Paste text to encode or Base64 to decode

howItWorks: Paste plain text into the box and press Encode to Base64 to get the encoded version.
Paste a Base64 string and press Decode from Base64 to recover the original text.
All processing uses your browser's built-in text and binary handling; nothing is sent to a server.
examples: Encode an API key or small payload so it can travel safely inside a JSON string or header.
Decode a Base64 string you found in a log or config to see the original message.
Turn a short snippet of text into Base64 for testing an encoder on another system.

faq.q: Is my text uploaded when I encode or decode?
faq.a: No. Encoding and decoding run completely inside your browser using JavaScript. The text you paste never leaves your device.

faq.q: Does it handle Unicode and emoji correctly?
faq.a: Yes. The tool uses UTF-8 encoding, so accented characters, emoji and non-Latin scripts survive the round trip unchanged.

faq.q: What happens if the Base64 is invalid?
faq.a: The decoder checks the alphabet and padding and shows a clear error instead of producing garbage output.
